summary: HR lets a named person see pay for chosen departments only, while pay stops leaking to everyone else through reports, range filters, filter suggestions and the dashboard.
ticket_rules: A reviewer sees pay exactly for people in their departments as of today by the company clock.
Nobody else learns a pay value, order or threshold through any report, filter, suggestion or dashboard.
Everything this ticket does not describe behaves as it does today.

criteria.text: by-id pay reads answer like a never-used id for non-reviewers
custom reports, snapshots and filter suggestions carry no pay for others
a department move dated ahead changes nothing until its date

derived-surface-omitted.build: strip pay in the employee serializer
derived-surface-omitted.hidden_case_it_fails: the pay cell of a custom report

central_change_risk: A read filter on the pay table covers reads but not report cells computed elsewhere or dated moves.

measured.slips: snapshot cells, custom report pay cell, move dated ahead
